subject: QuantumPay CAIQ: evidence orchestration and ownership plan
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <security@quantumpay.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Lee <procurement@quantumpay.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QuantumPay CAIQ intake and evidence timeline

Hi David —

Thanks for taking this on. QuantumPay is starting a CAIQ review for our payments platform audit and we need a mapping of Redwood's controls to the CAIQ questions plus sample evidence for a subset of key controls (network segmentation, key management, telemetry & retention).

Can you provide:
- a completed CAIQ spreadsheet (we attached the blank template) with references to artifacts we can pull during the audit;
- a list of owners for each evidence item;
- a 10-business-day intake timeline for the first tranche (about 20 high-priority questions).

We'd like to kick off next week. FYI procurement (cc) will add standard NDA/LOE language if necessary.

Appreciate it—
Marta Ruiz
Sr. Security Engineer, QuantumPay
security@quantumpay.com

-- Attachment: QP-CAIQ-template.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <security@quantumpay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Daniel Lee <procurement@quantumpay.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuantumPay CAIQ intake and evidence timeline

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the template. We're ready to support this; putting Kimberly and Priyom on the thread to coordinate evidence collection and owner assignment. High level plan:

1) Intake and prioritization (days 1–2): we will pre-fill the template for 20 priority items and mark candidate artifacts.
2) Owner assignment (days 2–4): each artifact will have a named owner and an expected delivery date.
3) Evidence delivery (days 5–10): owners upload artifacts to a secure intake folder; we will provide a short narrative for each control.

I attached our working mapping (redwood-caiq-mapping-v0.9.xlsx) and examples for telemetry (kv-cache-telemetry-sample.log) and our network diagram.

Quick questions for planning:
- Is the intake folder okay to be hosted on our shared S3 link (pre-signed) or do you require GAIA/your portal?
- Are any controls in scope for vendor access/filtered redaction?

We'll get the pre-filled sheet back to you by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com

-- Attachments: redwood-caiq-mapping-v0.9.xlsx; kv-cache-telemetry-sample.log; network-diagram-redwood.png

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marta Ruiz <security@quantumpay.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuantumPay CAIQ intake and evidence timeline

On Fri, Jun 25, 2027 at 11:08 AM David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> I attached our working mapping (redwood-caiq-mapping-v0.9.xlsx) and examples for telemetry (kv-cache-telemetry-sample.log) and our network diagram.

Hi all —

I've reviewed the v0.9 mapping and started annotating the following items that typically require additional context for CAIQ reviewers:

- CCM-SEC-02 (network segmentation): include diagram + firewall rule excerpt + change ticket reference.
- CCM-KEY-01 (key management): provide KMS policy snippet and HSM attestation statement.
- CCM-TELE-03 (telemetry retention): include sample log (we attached kv-cache-telemetry-sample.log) and the retention configuration screenshots.

Action items I propose:
- Priyom: own KMS policy extraction and HSM vendor contact (deliver by Wed).
- Marissa: collect ticket numbers and network firewall rule excerpts (deliver by Thu).
- David: confirm intake method with Marta (S3 presigned vs portal).

Marta — for the intake folder, S3 presigned links are fine for initial exchange, but let us know if you prefer we push into QuantumPay's shared portal later. Also flag any redaction constraints now so owners can sanitize artifacts.

Kimberly Park
Security Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

-- Attachment: annotated-redwood-notes.pdf (6 pages, internal)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <security@quantumpay.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Daniel Lee <procurement@quantumpay.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuantumPay CAIQ intake and evidence timeline

Hi Marta —

We consolidated owners and delivery dates for the first tranche and uploaded the artifacts to the intake S3 bucket (pre-signed links sent to your inbox). Summary below:

- Network segmentation (CCM-SEC-02): Marissa Cole — firewall rules + topology diagram — ETA Thu 06/30
- Key management (CCM-KEY-01): Priyom Das — KMS policy + HSM attestation — ETA Wed 06/30
- Telemetry retention (CCM-TELE-03): David Kim — sample logs + retention config — ETA Fri 07/02
- Additional 17 priority items: owners assigned in redwood-caiq-mapping-v0.9.xlsx (see Owner column)

We also included short narratives for each control in the spreadsheet to help your reviewers. If QuantumPay needs signed attestations for any item, flag them and we will route to Legal for a short attestation letter.

Thanks — we'll ping when everything is in the folder.

Marissa Cole
Customer Security Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

-- Attachments: owner-rollup.csv (internal); upload-manifest.txt
